title: 剑客
author: 贾岛
intro: Ten years spent grinding one sword, and it has never been used. In four short lines a swordsman — really the poet — asks: is there an injustice I can put right?
analysis: 这首诗借一个剑客的口气说话。前两句说：我花了十年磨一把剑，剑刃像霜一样白亮锋利，却还从来没有试过。后两句说：今天我把它拿出来给你看，谁遇到了不公平的事？全诗表面写剑，其实写人——“十年磨一剑”比喻多年苦学、积累本领，“霜刃未曾试”是说才能还没有机会施展，最后一问充满自信，想为天下打抱不平。这种借一个东西来表达自己志向的写法叫“托物言志”。贾岛的诗多写清冷孤寂，这首却很豪爽。“十年磨一剑”今天还常用，比如说一部作品、一项研究花了很多年才完成。
analysisEn: The poem speaks in the voice of a swordsman. “For ten years I have ground this one sword; its frost-white blade has never been tried. Today I hold it out to show you — who has a wrong that needs righting?” On the surface it is about a sword, but it is really about a person. Ten years of grinding stand for years of study and hard work; the untried blade is talent that has never had its chance. The final question is bold and confident: the speaker is ready to stand up for anyone treated unfairly. Expressing your own ambitions through an object like this is a common technique in Chinese poetry, called 托物言志 (“using a thing to speak your mind”). Jia Dao usually wrote quiet, chilly, lonely poems, which makes this short burst of heroism stand out. The phrase 十年磨一剑 is still used today for any work that took years to perfect — a novel, a film, a research project.
background: Jia Dao (779–843) was a former monk who struggled for years to pass the imperial exams and win office. The poem is usually read as a statement of the talent he hoped someone would finally put to use.
pronunciation: 曾 céng（未曾，曾经）；把示君 bǎ（拿）。
version: 采用通行版本。题目一作《述剑》。第三句“今日把示君”，《全唐诗》等作“把似君”（“似”通“示”，给人看），通行本作“示”。

lines.en: Ten years I have spent grinding one sword;

lines.lit: its frost-white blade has never been tried.
lines.en: its frost-bright edge has never been tested.

lines.lit: Today I hold it up to show you:
lines.en: Today I hold it out for you to see —

lines.lit: who has a matter of injustice?
lines.en: tell me, who has been wronged?

words.en: ten years to grind one sword — years of patient work
words.note: 今天仍是常用说法，比喻多年苦心准备。
诗里的说法，形容剑刃白亮锋利。
现代汉语说“从来没有”；“未曾”是书面语。
古义是“拿着”，现代汉语还有“把握”“把门”。
古代对人的尊称，现代汉语说“您”。
现代汉语有“打抱不平”“愤愤不平”。

imagery.name: 剑
imagery.zh: 剑代表多年练成的本领，也代表为天下除不平的志向。
imagery.en: The sword stands for skill built up over years, and for the wish to right the world’s wrongs.

imagery.name: 霜
imagery.zh: 用霜形容剑刃，写出它的白亮和寒气，也写出锋利。
imagery.en: Frost describes the blade: white, cold and razor-sharp.
